name: container-resource-panel
title: Container Resource Panel
description: Painel read-only dos recursos de um container Docker: status (running/exited/restarting/paused/dead/created), health, CPU/MEM com limites e barras, network rx/tx, block I/O read/write, restart count com cor, portas publicadas, env vars (com masked) e mounts. Inspirado em Portainer / Docker Desktop.
